catalysts.headline: Affirm reported fiscal Q1 2027 results (qtr ended 2026-09-30): revenue $1.26B (+35% YoY, beat consensus ~$1.21-1.233B); GMV $14.4B (+34% YoY, 12th straight quarter of >30% GMV growth); GAAP diluted EPS $0.47-0.48 (sources vary), net income $164M (vs $81M YoY); active consumers +19% YoY to 28.7M, active merchants +48% YoY to 621K; Affirm Card GMV +117% YoY to $3.3B. catalysts.headline: Ahead of the Fed's Oct 28 decision, traders' odds of a rate hold fell to 53% from 78.4% (LSEG data), shifting the macro backdrop for rate-sensitive fintech names including AFRM into month-end.
catalysts.source: Reuters/LSEG data cited in secondary summary

catalysts.headline: AFRM rose 4.6% to close near $73, a partial recovery following the Sam's Club deal and a broader fintech rebound.
AFRM closed at $70.08, down approximately 3.2%, in the days following the Sam's Club announcement.

Affirm announced a multi-year, exclusive deal to be Sam's Club's buy-now-pay-later provider. Online checkout on SamsClub.com is expected to go live in the coming weeks ahead of the holidays; in-store checkout at club locations is targeted for 2027. Affirm had lost Walmart's BNPL business to Klarna in 2025; Sam's Club had offered no installment option before this (BJ's has had one since 2021; Costco added Affirm in May 2025). Financial terms were not disclosed.
catalysts.impact: Shares closed down 1.51% at $72.40 on announcement day per TIKR

catalysts.headline: A hotter-than-expected September CPI inflation reading triggered a broad market selloff; AFRM shares fell more than 11.5% intraday at one point.
